# hafroreports: Helpers for building assessment reports

Figures, tables and input data for the MFRI stock assessment reports,
used by the stock assessment repositories (01-cod, 02-had-targets,
03-sai, …).

Documentation, with articles on the main workflows, is at
<https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/>:

- [Input data for SAM and
  Muppet](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/articles/input-data.html)
- [History
  tables](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/articles/history-tables.html)
- [Advice sheet figures and
  tables](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/articles/advice-sheets.html)
- [Tech report
  figures](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/articles/techreport-figures.html)
- [The layout of a stock
  repository](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/articles/stock-repository.html)

The badges and the site work once the workflows have run on GitHub and
GitHub Pages is enabled for the `gh-pages` branch.

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("hafro/hafroreports")
```

SAMutils, stockassessment and rmuppet (in Enhances) are needed only for
the SAM and Muppet functions.

## Development

### Code formatting

This projects uses [Air](https://posit-dev.github.io/air/), you may need
to configure your editor accordingly. See
<https://posit-dev.github.io/air/editors.html>

### Testing within an assessment model

Assessment models use
[renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/articles/renv.html), and your
development version will need to be installed before you can test.

`{r} renv::install("local::../hafroreports", dependencies = "never")`

…once your changes are pushed / merged, switch back to the github
version with:

`{r} renv::install("github::hafro/hafroreports") renv::snapshot()`

# Package index

## Input data

Weight and maturity keys, survey indices and catch at age from a pax
database, and the model input table.

- [`hr_input_data_lw()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_input_data_lw.md)
  : Extract length–weight data from a pax database
- [`hr_input_data_maturity_key()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_input_data_maturity_key.md)
  : Estimate maturity-at-length key from survey data
- [`hr_input_data_si_index()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_input_data_si_index.md)
  : Compute survey index data (abundance and biomass at age)
- [`hr_si_scale_by_strata_stations()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_si_scale_by_strata_stations.md)
  : Scale survey abundance to strata using a station list
- [`hr_pool_years()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_pool_years.md)
  : Pool years for an age-length key
- [`hr_input_data_landings()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_input_data_landings.md)
  : Aggregate total landings by year from a pax database
- [`hr_input_data_combine()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_input_data_combine.md)
  : Combine survey indices into single input_data

## SAM input

- [`hr_sam_cn()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_cn.md)
  : Build SAM catch-at-age matrix
- [`hr_sam_conf()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_conf.md)
  : Build SAM configuration for Icelandic haddock (deprecated)
- [`hr_sam_cw()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_cw.md)
  : Build SAM catch mean weight matrix
- [`hr_sam_dat()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_dat.md)
  : Assemble SAM input data
- [`hr_sam_lf()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_lf.md)
  : Build SAM landing fraction matrix
- [`hr_sam_mo()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_mo.md)
  : Build SAM proportion mature matrix
- [`hr_sam_nm()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_nm.md)
  : Build SAM natural mortality matrix
- [`hr_sam_pf()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_pf.md)
  : Build SAM proportion of F before spawning matrix
- [`hr_sam_pm()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_pm.md)
  : Build SAM proportion of M before spawning matrix
- [`hr_sam_smb()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_smb.md)
  : Build SAM spring (SMB) survey index matrix
- [`hr_sam_smh()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_smh.md)
  : Build SAM autumn (SMH) survey index matrix
- [`hr_sam_sw()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_sam_sw.md)
  : Build SAM stock mean weight matrix

## Muppet

- [`hr_muppet_input_datafiles()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_muppet_input_datafiles.md)
  : Prepare MUPPET input data files
- [`hr_muppet_input_optionfile()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_muppet_input_optionfile.md)
  : Prepare a MUPPET option file for a given assessment year
- [`hr_muppet_input_progwts()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_muppet_input_progwts.md)
  : Generate MUPPET projection weights file
- [`hr_muppet_mcmc()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_muppet_mcmc.md)
  : Run the MCMC of a MUPPET model
- [`hr_muppet_run()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_muppet_run.md)
  : Run MUPPET model and return results

## History tables and assessment summaries

- [`hr_update_hist()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_update_hist.md)
  : Merge and update a historical data series
- [`hr_assessment_from_fit()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_assessment_from_fit.md)
  : Assessment summary from a SAM fit
- [`hr_assessment_from_sag()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_assessment_from_sag.md)
  : Fetch assessment results from ICES SAG
- [`hr_assessment_template()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_assessment_template.md)
  : Create an empty assessment data template

## Advice sheet data

- [`hr_advice_data_assessment()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_data_assessment.md)
  : Reshape wide assessment data into long format
- [`hr_advice_data_landings()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_data_landings.md)
  : Prepare landings data for advice plots and tables
- [`hr_advice_data_prognosis()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_data_prognosis.md)
  : Assemble prognosis summary data for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_data_tac()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_data_tac.md)
  : Assemble TAC and landings history for advice sheet

## Advice sheet figures

- [`hr_advice_banner()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_banner.md)
  : Advice sheet banner
- [`hr_advice_plot_fpl()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_fpl.md)
  : Plot fishing pressure for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_fproxy()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_fproxy.md)
  : Plot the fishing pressure proxy for a category 3 advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_index()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_index.md)
  : Plot a survey biomass index for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_landings()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_landings.md)
  : Plot landings by gear for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_recruitment()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_recruitment.md)
  : Plot recruitment for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_retro()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_retro.md)
  : Plot retrospective comparison of recent assessments for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_plot_ssb()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_plot_ssb.md)
  : Plot spawning stock biomass for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_y_scale()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_y_scale.md)
  : Y axis for advice sheet figures

## Advice sheet tables

- [`hr_advice_table_chr()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_table_chr.md)
  : Format the constant harvest rate (chr) advice calculation table
- [`hr_advice_table_prog_input()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_table_prog_input.md)
  : Format forecast assumptions table for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_table_prognosis()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_table_prognosis.md)
  : Format prognosis table for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_table_rfb()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_table_rfb.md)
  : Format the rfb (ratio, f, b) advice calculation table
- [`hr_advice_table_tac()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_table_tac.md)
  : Format TAC history table for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_ref_table()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_ref_table.md)
  : Format reference points table for advice sheet
- [`hr_advice_basis_table()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_advice_basis_table.md)
  : Format advice basis table
- [`hr_ref_points_tonnes()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_ref_points_tonnes.md)
  : Biomass reference points in tonnes

## Tech report figures

- [`hr_techreport_plot_catch_age_bubble()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catch_age_bubble.md)
  : Plot catch-at-age bar chart coloured by year class
- [`hr_techreport_plot_catch_age_prop()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catch_age_prop.md)
  : Plot catch proportions by year class (total and stacked)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_catch_region()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catch_region.md)
  : Plot catch by geographic region (total and stacked)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_catch_wgt_growth()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catch_wgt_growth.md)
  : Plot catch weight growth by age and year class
- [`hr_techreport_plot_catchdepth()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catchdepth.md)
  : Plot catch by depth class (total and stacked)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_catchspatial()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_catchspatial.md)
  : Plot spatial distribution of catch
- [`hr_techreport_plot_comm_joy_ldist()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_comm_joy_ldist.md)
  : Plot commercial length-frequency distribution as a joy plot
- [`hr_techreport_plot_cpue()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_cpue.md)
  : Plot CPUE time series by gear group
- [`hr_techreport_plot_discards()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_discards.md)
  : Plot discard rates by gear for a given species
- [`hr_techreport_plot_dsl_lc()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_dsl_lc.md)
  : Length frequency of the catch with the DSL reference points
- [`hr_techreport_plot_dsl_ml()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_dsl_ml.md)
  : Mean length of the catch by year with L_F=M
- [`hr_techreport_plot_landings_country()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_landings_country.md)
  : Plot landings by country
- [`hr_techreport_plot_landings_gear()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_landings_gear.md)
  : Plot Icelandic landings by gear (total and stacked)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_lbindex()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_lbindex.md)
  : Plot length-based survey biomass index
- [`hr_techreport_plot_management()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_management.md)
  : Plot management history (advice, TAC, and landings)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_maturity()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_maturity.md)
  : Plot maturity-at-age by year class
- [`hr_techreport_plot_maturityweight()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_maturityweight.md)
  : Plot maturity as a function of stock weight
- [`hr_techreport_plot_muppetfit_selection()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_muppetfit_selection.md)
  : Plot MUPPET model selection and fit diagnostics
- [`hr_techreport_plot_numboats()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_numboats.md)
  : Plot number of vessels accounting for 95% of catch
- [`hr_techreport_plot_quotatransfer()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_quotatransfer.md)
  : Plot quota transfers between years and between species
- [`hr_techreport_rfb_theme()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.md)
  [`hr_techreport_plot_rfb_index()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.md)
  [`hr_techreport_plot_rfb_lc()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.md)
  [`hr_techreport_plot_rfb_ml()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.md)
  [`hr_techreport_plot_rfb_f()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.md)
  : Tech report figures of the rfb rule
- [`hr_techreport_plot_sampling_overview()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_sampling_overview.md)
  : Plot sampling coverage by month, gear, and sampling type
- [`hr_techreport_plot_sampling_position()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_sampling_position.md)
  : Map biological sampling locations overlaid on catch density
- [`hr_techreport_plot_samres_combfit()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_samres_combfit.md)
  : Plot SAM combined survey fit
- [`hr_techreport_plot_samres_resid()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_samres_resid.md)
  : Plot SAM model residuals by year, age, and fleet
- [`hr_techreport_plot_survey_age_bubble()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_survey_age_bubble.md)
  : Plot spring and autumn survey indices at age coloured by year class
- [`hr_techreport_plot_survey_byarea()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_survey_byarea.md)
  : Plot survey biomass by geographic region (total and stacked)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_survey_ldist()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_survey_ldist.md)
  : Plot survey length distribution by year
- [`hr_techreport_plot_survey_ldist_joy()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_survey_ldist_joy.md)
  : Plot survey length distributions as joy plots for both surveys
- [`hr_techreport_plot_survey_location()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_survey_location.md)
  : Map survey station locations with catch density
- [`hr_techreport_plot_wm_center()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_wm_center.md)
  : Plot catch weight vs. stock weight relationship (centre panel)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_wm_left()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_wm_left.md)
  : Plot stock weight growth model (left panel)
- [`hr_techreport_plot_wm_right()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_plot_wm_right.md)
  : Plot year-effect estimates from stock weight growth model (right
  panel)
- [`hr_techreport_dsl_basis()`](https://hafro.github.io/hafroreports/reference/hr_techreport_dsl_basis.md)
  : Length-based reference point basis of a DSL figure
